netword_details: Shigar da hanyar sadarwa / ƙarin bayani

messages.game_over: Sihrin ya gushe… Gonarku tana hutawa a yanzu. Amma da safe sabo, sabuwar fata za ta sake girma. Don Allah duba umarnin wasan kuma gwada lokacin da ka shirya!
messages.harvest: Aikin ban mamaki yau! Gonarku ta yi kyau ƙarƙashin kulawarku — huta kaɗan ka dawo nan ba da daɗewa ba don ci gaba da girman sihirin.
messages.session_started: Barka, Mai sihiri! Filayen suna jiran tabarmar ka — tsiro suna motsawa, kuma sihiri yana zagayawa cikin ƙasa. Mu haɓaka wani abu mai kyau a yau!
messages.confirm_claim: Kuna da tabbacin kuna son karɓar ta hanyar
messages.available: Lambar lokaci / kyautar bayanai na samuwa ne kawai a Najeriya.
messages.unavailable: Wannan sabis ba ya samuwa a yankinku
messages.watch_ads: Kalli gajeren hangen nesa na sihiri (talla) don adana tafiyarka da kuma buɗe kyauta ta musamman. Daji na tuna waɗanda suka ɗauki lokaci — bari sihiri ya yi aiki a gare ku!
messages.reques_recieved: An karɓi buƙatarku ta lada cikin nasara kuma ana aiki a kai. Za a aika muku bayan ƙarewar lokaci!
messages.leaderboard: Jerin manyan 'yan wasa yana dogara ne akan jimillar maki da mai amfani ya tara a cikin app ɗin
messages.seed_info: Zaɓi irin ku don shuka. Kowace shuka na da matakai guda huɗu na musamman.
messages.upgrade_message: Bude cikakken sihiri tare da Premium — babu talla, ƙarin lada, da fa'idodi na musamman. Daji yana son jarumawa!
messages.choose_provider: Zaɓi Mai Bayarwa don ci gaba
messages.withdrawal_warning: Uh oh!!! Ba ka da isasshen kuɗi a cikin USD don cirewa. Da fatan za ka ci gaba da wasa don canza makin ka zuwa USD.
messages.convert_warning: Uh oh!!! Ba ka da isassun token don canjawa. Da fatan za ka ci gaba da wasa don samun token.

plants.stage0: Barka da zuwa farawa mai sauƙi! Sihrin yana motsawa a cikin ƙasa. Matakin girma 1 ya kai!
plants.stage1: Taya murna da ci gabanka! Ganyenka suna ƙarfi. Matakin girma 2 ya kai!
plants.stage2: Ka samu! Daji na furta sunanka. Matakin girma 3 ya kai!
plants.stage3: Wani babban mataki ne! Girbin sihiri na jiran ku. Matakin girma 4 ya kai!

comfirmation.title: Tabbatarwa
comfirmation.delete_account: Kuna da tabbacin kuna son share asusunku? Wannan aiki ba za a iya dawo da shi ba.
comfirmation.logout: Kuna da tabbacin kuna son fita? Za a mayar da ku zuwa shafin shiga.
comfirmation.close_game: Kuna da tabbacin kuna son rufe wasan? Za a mayar da ku zuwa shafin gida.
comfirmation.confirm_upgrade: Asusunka bai haɓaka ba a yanzu, Tabbatar da biyan {{amount}} don haɓaka asusunka zuwa premium
comfirmation.token_address: Shigar da adireshin manufa a ƙasa don cire ma'aunin ku na {{amount}} USD

inventory.confirm_payment: Tabbatar da biyan {{amount}} don sayan {{purchaseQty}} na {{item}}
inventory.select_payment_option: Zaɓi hanyar biyan kuɗi don ci gaba
